annotations.title: Companies in Korea hiring for visa-sponsored roles

description: Employers in South Korea with open jobs on Seoulstart that mention visa sponsorship or are professional roles that usually hire on the E-7 visa, ranked by how many of their postings mention sponsorship, then by how many are likely E-7 roles, then by open jobs. This is the public list from seoulstart.com/jobs/visa-sponsorship-companies. A mention is a strong sign, not a promise of sponsorship for a given role.

include_teaching.description: true: also list schools and academies whose roles are mostly teaching jobs (usually the E-2 visa). Default false.

limit.description: How many employers to return (default 20, at most 50).
